{{Quote|I'm sorry, Duchess. But what you're saying, it's impossible!|The police captain, to Duchess Satine Kryze|<ref name="corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] '''police captain''' served in the [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Guard]] during a [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] attack by the [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The [[Police officer/Legends|police]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was stationed at the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he aided [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and several [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]]s in their investigation of [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] found in a [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|tea]].

When they discovered the source of the problem in a warehouse, two corrupt officers barred them from entry and attempted to strike Satine, but the captain knocked both of them out. Upon entering the warehouse, they found [[Moogan/Legends|Moogans]] and [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] preparing more tainted tea and began to fire. The captain was shot in the shoulder and was dragged out of the way by [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]]s.

After the criminals' defeat, Satine ordered the warehouse burned to the ground. The captain tried objecting, stating that the warehouse contained vital evidence, but the Duchess demanded that he comply or she'll consider him a part of this conspiracy. Reluctantly, the captain complied with orders.

==Behind the scenes==
The police captain is voiced by actor [[Tom Kane]].<ref name="Corruption Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode305.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Corruption}}</ref>
